draft.text: You came in for your annual exam and to talk about your heart palpitations.
We reviewed your medical history and your recent event monitor results.
Your palpitations may be related to stress, and your event monitor showed episodes of atrial fibrillation with pauses.
We will discuss next steps during your next visit.
